name: seated patella mobilization
description: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.
